DefaultDialogue: Isn’t it a lovely day? Well, lovely for Weaver's Fen. If you need any ingredients, you can always get them at the Trading Post.
Gentle stranger, could you help an old woman? I fear my daughter could be in danger.
Oh goodness! Hazel, what were you doing? She knows such magics are forbidden in the Fen!
Binding animal parts together? That sounds like something the Crone would do!
I don't know how I will go on without my Hazel... This island will never be satisfied until it has taken everything from you…
Isn’t the Fen the prettiest place you’ve ever been? It’s home to so much life, in the waters, in the trees, in the air.
Ever talked to a man you fancied and he opens his mouth and the fancy evaporates?
Felt the strange heat in the fog? It clings to your skin like a wet sock. Could have you feeling clammy.
Hah, watch yourself. You don’t want to mess with a reptile her size. She’s a bit grumpy today. And her teeth can cut through iron. Chomp chomp.
Hey, mind you don’t make too much noise, even on the road. You never know what might come running out of the murk.
It’s quiet out there. Far too quiet.
If you bested The Denier, then perhaps you can be of further use.
Well, this is grim, isn’t it? Am I the only one left?
I will remain vigilant. I will not lose faith, nor hope, nor conviction. Despite the fact that I carry on the hunt alone. For now at least…
Just look at this incredible stonework! Can't you just feel the weight of the years, pressing down?
Oh, hello! Perfect timing! I'm Na Li, the architect. You've probably seen my work in the Ebonscale settlement.
Well, this is puzzling. Judging by the level of erosion, sediment layers, and my chemical analysis… these stones could be several orders of magnitude older than I first guessed.
I will not allow myself to grow too excited just yet.
The future is bright, and I am going to be the one to build it.
If you happen to spot a woman hiding in some absurd corner of a ruin, do let her know she has won and the game is over. Thank you!
Finally, a traveler along the road!
Hmm, yeah, that blue-ish hue means starmetal… and the three-faced queen on the obverse…there’s no doubt about it. This coin came from the Canopus dig site!
Ahem! Okay, let’s see what we’ve got here. Hmm… If I turn it this way and hold it against the other coin… Some sort of bridge? Nein… An aquedu-- Aha!
Have you found any more clues? Or, uh, my wife?
That was fun. In hindsight, the added threat of bodily harm did make it more thrilling. I am just glad she is back with me.
I knew Leonie wouldn't be able to resist another puzzle. Be honest, she's loving this, right? She’s not too worried?
She must be so worried about me…
I knew Leonie wouldn't be able to resist another puzzle. Be honest, she's loving this, right? She’s not too worried?
I think our next game will feature less… excitement. Ah, well, lesson learned.
I think our next game will feature less… excitement. Ah, well, lesson learned.
Alright, Torchy, stay cool. Everything is going to be fine. Oh… could you come back a bit later?
Well met, traveler! People call me Torchy, on account of my… interests.
You seem to be a bright light yourself, my friend. These torches cannot have been easy to acquire.
Yes, my friend. With what you acquired, Eternal Flame is finally within our reach!
Once I am back in Restless Shore, I will create the world's first Eternal Flame!
Greetings, denizen of this fine, fetid land. Tis I! Samuel Worthington Bloodgood the Third, hunter extraordinaire, at your service!
Oh, you must be the hardy sort, to wander so freely in a place like this! I dare say you might even be capable with that weapon of yours.
It would be so terribly unfair of me to deprive you of another contest, since I so RUDELY abandoned my own attempt. Shall we have another?
I am becoming increasingly eager to prove myself to you, my friend.
I understand I am stretching the bounds of your credulity right now. Truly, I do. Uh, yes, I, uh, I have… a confession to make, if you will hear it.
Well, I believe retirement is in my future. A quiet, obscure, shameless retirement where no one need witness my forebear’s disappointment.
The stench of this swamp… it's so beautiful.
Stop for a moment, friend. Take a deep breath. Yes, drink it in. What does the Fen smell like to you?
You can close your eyes against sight, plug your ears against sound… but you can't escape the smell, no.
Some folks are saying that a warm cup of mead is the perfect way to stave off the illness.
You shall refer to me as Mistress Bergeron. I hope you like it as much as I do.
Stand upright and look me in the eye when you address me, Marauder. Now what is your business? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
Stand upright and look me in the eye when you address me, Marauder. Now what is your business?
Turn around, weak one, and return the direction from which you approached.
I am here on official business. I have no time to trifle with you.
Why continue to wander alone when the Syndicate offers so much?
Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
Ah, excuse me, I was lost in thought. How might the Syndicate serve you?
You may be surprised to know that la famille Rubis has a lineage of great warriors.
To be free to practice the religion of your conscience without persecution. It was different back en France.
Those who are truly blind cannot see even in the light.
If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee? [ Level 28 required for Weaver's Fen faction missions ]
If you always give, you will always have. What may I give you, devotee?
Arrogance invites ruin. Humility receives benefits.
The bird does not sing because he has the answer. He sings because he has a song.
Takes a certain kind to travel through the Fen. You best be warned I'll have my eye on you, stranger.
I was skeptical when I first saw you stroll by here - but you've proven me wrong.
Always good to see a familiar face back here in the Fen. People are still talking about all you did here.
Can't talk yet. Must monitor the experiment, very volatile. Must watch the condensation… mustn't talk… mustn't... sleep…
But I don't mean to be rude, just thought you were delivering my alembics.
But I don't mean to be rude, just thought you were delivering my alembics.
But I don't mean to be rude to a fellow Syndicate member, especially.
But I don't mean to be rude, just thought you were delivering my alembics.
With the bear threat eliminated, we can study the physio-botanical aspects of this region further.
Hey there. Always nice to see a friendly face out here. If there's anything you need, just ask.
Heard you tromping through the brush from yards out. Thought you were one of those Syndicate clowns. They scare off the game.
Now I can avoid accidentally stepping on those field researchers…because they reek of bear urine.
Hello! I'd love to chat, but the bears might overhear.
Hello! I'd love to chat, but the bears might overhear.
Every time I don't get eaten by a bear, I'll think of you.
Where's Theo with that bear repellent? Did he get distracted again?
Where's Theo with that bear repellent? Did he get distracted again?
Now I can finally concentrate on my work.
Oh boy, I must have pissed off someone at headquarters to get this assignment.
Oh boy, I must have pissed off someone at headquarters to get this assignment.
Thanks for the urine, I guess.
Have you seen any bears? Did they say anything about me?
Have you seen any bears? Did they say anything about me?
It's probably for the best that the bears and I don't become best friends… Gotta keep a professional distance.
Good day! Resting in Twillen for a bit? I bet some new missions have come up on the townboard.
Hello, adventurer! Welcome to Twillen. You seem smart. But are you?
